title: Raj and the Jam Jug
lines: Raj had a job. He got the jam.
The jam was in a big jug.
Raj can jog. He jogs a lot.
The jug tips and jam is on his cap!
"Look at the jam!" said Raj. He was sad.
Dad was not mad. He gets a rag.
Dad rubs the cap and gets a bun.
Raj had a jam bun and did a jig!

questions.ask: What happened while Raj was jogging?
questions.listenFor: The jug tipped and the jam went all over his cap. It is right there in the story. If they only say "jam," ask "and where did it go?"

questions.ask: What did Dad use to clean up?
questions.listenFor: A rag. One word is a fine answer. Have them find the line and read it back so they can prove it.

questions.ask: Do you think Raj had a good day or a rough day? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story - the spilled jam, or the bun and the jig at the end. The reason is the whole point.
